Container.Name: wame
Container.Overview: WhatsApp account as an HTTP API + MCP server (wame serve). LAN/VPN only: /data holds the WhatsApp session keys, so never publish it through the Cloudflare tunnel. Image built locally from /mnt/nvme_cache/appdata/wame-src (unraid/install.sh); distroless, no shell. Runs as 99:100; SQLite at /mnt/nvme_cache/appdata/wame/wame.db (direct pool path, backed up by db-dump + kopia). WAME_TOKEN is the owner secret (copy in Infisical project "wame"). First login: docker logs -f wame and scan the QR, or wame admin -server https://wame.emu.lat. Named tokens: docker exec wame wame token create NAME -scopes read -expires 720h.

Config.Name: API
Config.Description: HTTP API, /mcp and /docs (reached at the VLAN IP; no published port)

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: wame.db: WhatsApp session keys, messages, tokens. Owned 99:100, mode 700. Direct pool path (bypasses FUSE).

Config.Name: WAME_TOKEN
Config.Description: Owner secret (16+ chars, full access). Kept in Infisical project wame.

Config.Name: WAME_RATE
Config.Description: Max messages sent per minute (0 = unlimited)

Config.Name: WAME_WEBHOOK
Config.Description: POST incoming messages as JSON to this URL (e.g. an n8n webhook). Empty = off.

Config.Name: WAME_WEBHOOK_FILTER
Config.Description: Only deliver matching messages, e.g. type=text&from_me=false
